## Media Inventory & Rates
1. Highway Unipoles & City Hoardings
   - Locations: NH-48 (Delhi-Gurugram), Western Express Highway (Mumbai), Outer Ring Road (Bengaluru), HITEC City (Hyderabad)
   - Standard Sizes: 40x20 ft, 50x25 ft, 60x30 ft, 20x10 ft
   - Illumination: Frontlit LED, Backlit Flex
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹1,20,000 / month

2. Metro Station Domination & Train Wraps
   - Networks: Delhi Metro (DMRC Blue/Yellow lines), Namma Metro Bengaluru, Mumbai Metro
   - Placements: Concourse lightboxes, ticket counter panels, entry/exit archways, coach interiors, full exterior train wraps
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹85,000 / month

3. Airport Terminal Advertising
   - Hubs: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL T3), Kempegowda International Airport (BLR T1/T2), Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM T2)
   - Formats: Static lightboxes, digital video walls, conveyor belt hoardings, aerobridge wraps
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹1,80,000 / month

4. Digital OOH (DOOH) Screens
   - Venues: DLF Cyber Hub, Phoenix Marketcity, Brigade Gateway, Ambience Mall
   - Format: 4K P2.5/P3 Outdoor LED Billboards
   - Frequency: 10-second slots, 120+ plays / day
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹65,000 / month

5. Retail Mall & Atrium Drops
   - Venues: Top tier A malls across metro cities
   - Formats: Giant atrium hanging banners, escalator side graphics, standees, elevator wraps
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹45,000 / month

## Client Verification & Execution Workflow
- Step 1: Media Selection & Availability Check via online platform
- Step 2: Location Lock & Rate Confirmation
- Step 3: Artwork Pre-flight Check & In-House Plant Printing (flex / vinyl)
- Step 4: Physical Mounting & Electrical Illumination within 48 hours
- Step 5: Day and Night Geo-tagged Photo Proof of Display delivered to client dashboard
- Step 6: Fortnightly maintenance and structural integrity monitoring
